pid_text_references.text: This project aims to explore different control techniques for pendulum systems, including PID, Model Predictive Control (MPC), and Deep Learning methods. The project will involve simulations using Python and Gazebo, as well as real-world implementation using a Raspberry Pi and ODrive 3.6 motor controller.
- Develop a PID control algorithm based on the linearized model.
- Test the PID controller within the Python simulation environment.
- Implement the PID controller in the Gazebo simulation.
- Apply the PID controller to the physical system and observe performance.
